actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Keep the pool growing and avoid free-riders.

answer.explanation: Wallet is well above the 30% threshold, so baseline contribution of 80% is required. Round 10 is a multiple of 5, triggering the norm broadcast. No eligible free‑rider has met the two‑round low‑contribution condition simultaneously with contribution, so only contribution and broadcast are performed.
